raw_sections.summary:
Profile Summary
Full-Stack Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience across frontend and backend stacks proficient in JavaScript, React, Node.js, and REST APIs, with exposure to Java-based enterprise systems. Experienced in building scalable, reusable UI components, micro-frontend systems, web performance optimization, and shipping production-grade features at enterprise scale.
raw_sections.experience:
Experience Oracle Software Engineer
Oct 2024 – Nov 2025 Hyderabad, Telangana • Engineered a Manufacturing Task Scheduler SPA using Oracle UIF (React-based) framework, eliminating manual saved-search workflows and reducing work-order management time by 60% through real-time Gantt chart visualization, drag-and-drop scheduling, and operation monitoring.
Streamlined NetSuite business processes by developing custom workflows, UI interfaces, and form validations using SuiteScript API, automating record event handling across production modules and reducing manual data-entry overhead.
Diagnosed and resolved 12+ critical backend defects in NetSuite’s Java-based Item Fulfillment and Inventory Detail modules through systematic debugging and root-cause analysis, improving module-level reliability and performance across production workflows.
Ten20 Infomedia Software Engineer
Aug 2023 – Aug 2024 Hyderabad, Telangana
Shipped the full-stack VoiceBroadcast feature within one month using Node.js, React.js, and Redux, enabling 10M+ outbound IVR calls with real-time survey analytics across campaigns.
Improved VoiceBroadcast Metrics Dashboard performance by 40% through Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP, FCP) using lazy loading, code splitting, and image compression — validated via Lighthouse audits. • Delivered the NumberMasking feature from requirements to production using React, Node.js, and REST APIs, implementing 12+ use cases for privacy-focused call routing that connects callers without exposing real phone numbers.
Authored 200+ automated test cases using Mocha, Chai, and Supertest for the NumberMasking feature, achieving full functionality coverage and ensuring production reliability.
Established third-party API audit logging and webhook event delivery using RabbitMQ with exponential backoff retry logic, improving event delivery reliability and system resilience across distributed services.
